scientific_integrity: Integral homotopy is deduced from a fully enumerated acyclic discrete-Morse matching and a determinant-one signed integral Morse attaching matrix. A separately computed mod-two homology calculation is a corroborating check and is not substituted for the integral proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification of one graph only; no universal strongly regular or Doob-graph theorem, no equivariant homotopy classification, and equivalent unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Nine six-spheres in the triangle-free vertex complex of the Shrikhande graph
